description: This file defines a mock class for the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper interface, used for testing purposes in the Rialto server media handling component. It includes mock methods for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata from GstBuffer objects.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper interface for testing, providing mock methods to simulate adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Mock method to simulate adding protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve protection metadata data from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Mock method to remove protection metadata from a GstBuffer.
